name: condenser_3_zones_plate_correlations
title: Three-zone plate condenser with heat-transfer correlations (Thonon/Kuo)
summary: Plate condenser for R123 with water (or glycol) cooling: three refrigerant zones (desuperheating, condensation, subcooling) sized with LMTD and plate-heat-exchanger correlations (Thonon single phase, Kuo two phase); computes area, pressure drops, hold-up mass and volume.

verification.reference: EES stored solution stored in the source file (18 variables)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 17 common variables, 5 differ (rtol=0.001), max 5.56e-02 on DELTAp_cd; every input agrees exactly. The 5 differing variables are the integrated outputs (A_cd, DELTAp_cd, DELTAp_sf_cd, M_fluid_cd, V_cd), all traced to the R123 property library of EES 8 (2008) vs CoolProp in the superheated region (desuperheating duty = small difference of large enthalpies); within the 'older EES fluid models: up to a few %' tolerance of ees_import.md §11, explained in the README.
